flags.question: q3
flags.note: Options mix different kinds of actions (notify, substitute with ineligible stock, delay, release held lot, cancel), and some are not permitted, so they do not differ along one clear axis.

flags.question: q4
flags.note: Levels blend whether orders are sent at all with the shortfall percentage and the number of orders affected, so a record could fit two levels (e.g. one order short by 25-50% and the other complete).
